reason: B is the stronger proposal because it targets a specific single-phase BCC refractory-alloy regime, identifies a measurable dislocation mediator, and extends prior edge-dislocation findings to a falsifiable toughness prediction. Its intervention remains underspecified and its claim of enhanced edge mobility conflicts with evidence that lattice distortion can impede edge motion, but A is more seriously undermined by calling annealing-induced evolution “dynamic” recrystallization and by broadly assuming grain refinement and precipitate dissolution across dissimilar alloy classes.
